column1: # Game profile of Nintendo Switch Sports Resort (Switch 2, update v65536, which holds the whole game). Plays on the Mac: see README.md
# Nintendo EPD's sead / agl / gsys with Havok, SDK 22.2.10 built for the Switch 2 (Ounce), NVN2. From the NSP script's provisional profile (its heap and address-region checks), plus render_cond
# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the app's name comes from the package's control data (the NUP has none: the NSP script takes --app-name)
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk1 (nn::camera), subsdk2 (C / libc), subsdk3 (C / libc), subsdk4 (other C++)
# the Switch 2's 9 GB application pool; the NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource (virtual address memory). The game asks for a 7.47 GB heap (the NSP script's heap check,
# 2026-11-12), so the block is 12.4 GB with a 4.38 GB alias region; in its first 15 s the game's regions reach alias +2.82 GB (address-region check, 2026-11-12)
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0: the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode
# the game wraps draws in render conditions; drawn anyway, the Select User background is grey and the outfits black (README.md, Rendering)
